content: July 2026: Aiko transitioned from linear workflows to a declarative graph engine, enabling conditional execution, semantic triggers, and visual graph editing via Aiko Graph Studio.
July 2026: Memory system underwent structured migration into Phases A, B, and C, introducing entity tagging, unified search, and active recall hooks for schema evolution.
July 2026: Agentic workflows expanded with typed tool contracts, social posting tools, and enhanced job hunt capabilities (Greenhouse/Indeed/RSS integration).
July 2026: Voice and ASR systems upgraded to Silero v4+ state management, with native barge-in support, longer pre-speech buffers (~700ms), and S0/S1/S2/S3 incremental improvements.
July 2026: Skills module introduced concurrent per-user turns, cached embeddings, and token-cost estimation via filtered tool schemas to optimize LLM routing.
July 2026: Multi-user state isolation formalized with SQLCipher encryption, per-user state directories, and optional guest in-memory stores.
July 2026: Web dashboard UI initialized with OAuth branding, favicon, and session cookie signing for enhanced security.
